BagIt-Profile-Info.External-Description: A box of software archived with RetroArchiver, mixed ones included (floppies, CDs, DVDs): EDSK images of the floppies in data/, the files of each CD or DVD in a subfolder of data/ (CD01/, DVD01/), scans, comparison verdicts and metadata.json (schema retroarchiver-3, outcomes in English). Media-Type is the composition ("3 floppy, 1 CD"); Media-Expected and Media-Archived count all the media; Missing-Media lists them by name ("floppy 2, CD 1"). Bags closed by version 261017 follow profile 2 (docs/bagit-profile-2.json), with Box-Status in Italian.
